title: The big ph site of schemes
statement: Fix the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. For a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathrm{Sch}/S$ be the category of schemes in the chosen universe over $S$, with all $S$-morphisms. Its ph topology is the smallest Grothendieck topology [def-weil-pbc-topos] containing Zariski open covering families and every singleton $\{V\to T\}$ that is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and surjective (surjective on underlying points). Write $(\mathrm{Sch}/S)_{ph}$ for this big site, using an admissible small presentation in a larger universe, and $\mathrm{Sh}((\mathrm{Sch}/S)_{ph})$ for its sheaf topos [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].
